results: Third style opens with one fixed example, editable name/message, and the requested attribution layout
The previous shipped example migrates to the new default text without requiring a settings reset
Saving in the popup updates both platform pages without changing search input, favorites, theme, or language
Done saves edited fields; cross-page updates preserve an editor’s unsaved draft
Blank notes are rejected while the previous saved message remains intact
Names, markup-like text, placeholders, and newlines render literally and stay unchanged across language switches and reloads
Switching to other styles preserves the fixed note; entry and editor remain usable at narrow widths
The selected friend style, fixed note, and shared favorites survive a full browser restart
scope: Actual unpacked extension in isolated Edge; no external accounts.
